Name: Kenneth's Drink Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Drink Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds 50+ drinks to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Coffees like Hot White Coffee, Iced Mocha Coffee[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Milks like Small Milk Bottle, Tall Milk Bottle, Milk Carton[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Juices like Fresh Lemon Juice, Fresh Orange Juice, Tooberry Juice, Spicy Tomato Juice, Red Sunny Juice, Tropical Juice Can, Strawberry Smoothie, Orange Juice, Sunrise Citrus Juice, Sunset Exotic Juice, Mixed Berry Punch, Tropical Juice Can[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Teas like Popcorn Butter Tea, Rose Petal Tea, Fresh Mint Tea, Chamomile Tea, Blueberry Lavender Tea, Dark Cocoa Tea, Green Tea with Lime, Hibiscus Berry Tea, Lemon Ginger Tea, Spiced Apple Cider Tea[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Sodas like Dark Cola Bottle, Fizzy Cola, Orange Soda, Red Apple Soda, Grape Soda[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Ales and beers like Earthshaker Ale, Cloud Eleven Ale, Blue Label Beer, Pumpkin Ale, Classic Beer Mug[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Cocktails like Carrot Citrus Margarita, Lime Cosmopolitan, Pink Lady Cocktail, Cloudberry Daiquiri, Creamy Dream Martini, Flaming Humbaba[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Other drinks like Taro Bubble Tea, Sloe Gin Fizz, Spicy Red Grog[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Items like Empty Stone Mug - needed to buy teas via trade[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All drinks have buffs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All drinks are sold in Kenneth's Drink Shop building. The building has 5 shop variants.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No recipes for now, items are sold directly in the shop. Recipes will be added in a future update.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfection Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod does not block perfection even without recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
